item.title: Becerra, running for governor of California, faces a health insurance problem
item.description: The nation's uninsured rate hit a historical low when Xavier Becerra was health secretary. Now he wants to be California's next governor as Trump's actions have driven people off health insurance.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Trump administration's 75-country visa ban was illegal, judge rules
item.description: The U.S. stopped issuing visas for citizens of 75 countries because it said they were likely to need public assistance. A judge ruled the policy illegally discriminated on the basis of nationality.

item.title: Opinion: Mr. Rogers keeps finding a new neighborhood
item.description: MLB catcher Jake Rogers probably didn't know if he was coming or going the last several weeks: he's been a Detroit Tiger, a Baltimore Oriole, a Boston Red Sox, and now he's a Chicago White Sox.

item.title: As Flock battles public scrutiny, other police surveillance companies see an opening
item.description: Dozens of cities have canceled their contracts with Flock. Some are switching to other companies, but privacy experts say they're no better than Flock.

item.title: As Canada readies retaliatory tariffs, Mark Carney says his nation is 'at war' with U.S.
item.description: The U.S. has now imposed 50% tariffs on $20 billion worth of Canadian products. Prime Minister Mark Carney says Canada will match those tariffs "dollar for dollar" starting Sept. 8.
item.content:encoded:
